official_definition: Constellation Seal (When Deployed) Send 20px (Soul Core) from your Spirit in family "Galaxian"/"Astral Soul" to your Life.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [Constellation Seal] or [Constellation Seal: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [Constellation Seal]", "give [Constellation Seal]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
